title: Glissando - Act 2 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Glissando in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 2, Sirene.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Glissando is a cloth-covered serpent that blocks the route to Sirene. It is a gatekeeper fight, and its signature threat is that it can eat one of your party members partway through the encounter.

sections.title: Where to Find the Glissando
sections.content: Location: the Sirene area, Act 2, on the way to the second Axon. You must beat it to reach Sirene.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toIce, Dark
ResistsEarth, Light
AbsorbsNone

Ice and Dark both land, while Earth and Light are resisted. That combination points at Lune and Sciel rather than a Light-based party.

sections.title: How to Beat the Glissando
sections.content:
Two melee combos

Its tail slam is a three-hit combo that swipes back and forth before a heavy finish - long start-up, then fast. Its head slam is only two hits and pulls back obviously before it lands, which makes it the easier of the two to read.

Charm

Glissando sends out three pulses at one character in a rhythm. Only the third connects, and if it lands you lose control of that character while they attack the party. The Anti-Charm effect from the nearby Tisseur fight is the clean answer - see below.

It eats a character

At low health it swallows a party member and removes them from the fight. You cannot avoid it, but Breaking Glissando forces it to spit them back out, so keep Break pressure up as its health drops.

  • Ice and Dark; avoid Earth and Light.
  • Kill the Tisseur first for Anti-Charm - it is optional but makes this fight much cleaner.
  • Keep Break ready for when it swallows someone.
